option_summaries.--output-flag: output file (alternative to the positional form)
option_summaries.--run: run the calculations now, one after another
option_summaries.--collect: analyze calculations that have already been run
option_summaries.--redo: also redo calculations that were already complete
option_summaries.--max-time: total time budget; when it is exhausted, no new calculation starts
option_summaries.--estimate: estimate sweep time from the local calculation history and exit
option_summaries.--timeout: time limit per calculation, in seconds
option_summaries.--pseudo: force a specific pseudopotential, for example Fe=Fe.rel-pbe.UPF; repeatable
option_summaries.--insulator: use fixed occupations for an insulator or semiconductor
option_summaries.--execute: execute or submit; otherwise only simulate or write
option_summaries.--force: ignore the cache and prepare tasks again
option_summaries.--parallel: number of independent tasks to run simultaneously
option_summaries.--advanced: check structure, commands, units and collisions
option_summaries.--include-data: copy sources and artifacts into the publication bundle
option_summaries.--zip: create a ZIP instead of a folder
